title: OnlyChains
tagline: OnlyFans completely decentralized on the blockchain with Apecoin!
description:
This project connects encrypted IPFS storage for image uploads and Apecoin to "tip" or "subscribe" to creators. We support MetaMask, Rainbow, Coinbase Wallet, and WalletConnect.

Upon successful payment to a creator, their contents gets unlocked to that user. All Vyper contracts were tested with Titanoboa & iPython
how_its_made:
This project uses:
* NextJS and React for the server components and user interface
* Rainbowkit for the wallet authentication
* IPFS for encrypted decentralized file storage, readily accessible 
* Prisma and PostgreSQL for storing user and posts in a web2 style
* Vyper for the smart contracts
